checkpoint_state_columns.active_host_interaction: complete closed vv-agent.host-interaction-request.v1 JSON object (including prompt and schema_version) or null
checkpoint_state_columns.suspended_origin: closed JSON origin object or null
checkpoint_state_columns.crash_reload: load both fields and host_interaction_records before deciding whether to wake or wait
checkpoint_state_columns.old_schema: vv-agent.checkpoint.v7 is rejected; no fallback reader

replay.same_identity_and_digest: zero-write replay after claim release or producer crash

host_interaction_record_index.cleanup: retain consumed marker through next cycle commit or terminal acknowledgement; explicit checkpoint cleanup cascades rows

same_transaction: notification row owner-attempt CAS and delivered/ambiguous transition
notification row stable identity/digest and ambiguous transition

operations.claim: claim pending or expired claimed rows with notification_id, payload_digest, owner, and attempt CAS
operations.complete: owner-attempt CAS marks delivered or ambiguous; stale workers cannot complete

outcomes.retry: ambiguous -> pending with the same stable identity and digest
outcomes.abort: ambiguous -> aborted with an explicit abort_reason

reaper.pending_or_expired_claimed: claim and retry with owner-attempt CAS
reaper.ambiguous: enqueue reconciliation work; never blind-retry an uncertain callback
reaper.aborted: terminal until explicit checkpoint retention cleanup

operations.atomic: insert_if_absent

operations.name: load
operations.atomic: read_one

operations.name: claim
operations.atomic: compare_status_cycle_and_lease_then_claim_and_increment_resume_attempt_only_for_recovery_mode

operations.name: renew
operations.atomic: compare_claim_token_and_live_lease_then_update_lease_only

operations.name: progress
operations.atomic: compare_revision_and_claim_token_then_update_payload_and_revision_preserving_claim

operations.name: admit_deferred_batch
operations.atomic: compare revision claim and complete ordered batch outcomes then persist all journals events barrier and release claim once

operations.name: accept_deferred_batch
operations.atomic: CAS expected_revision plus active recovery claim token/cycle and exact current-batch decisions; persist every accepted journal entry, reconciliation audit, tool_call_deferred outbox event, barrier/status, and one claim release or write nothing

operations.name: resolve_deferred
operations.atomic: receipt-index-first internal revision CAS loop atomically persists journal index tombstone event barrier status and revision without claim

operations.name: admit_controller_command
operations.atomic: strict command digest and handle/resume-attempt/revision fences then one receipt/checkpoint/outbox CAS or write nothing

operations.name: produce_host_interaction
operations.atomic: require active claim then persist complete typed interaction request, record, host_interaction_requested event and UI notification outbox, release claim, and increment revision in one CAS; no worker wake

operations.name: resolve_controller_command
operations.atomic: admit command and return a durable wake-or-no-wake decision from the retained receipt; admission_revision=expected_revision+1 persists the full resolved_pending interaction record before return, while claim_and_consume_host_interaction_response commits consume_revision=admission_revision+1 before model/tool (8->9->10 is an example only)

operations.name: claim_and_consume_host_interaction_response
operations.atomic: lock checkpoint and matching host_interaction_record together; validate all fences; obtain checkpoint execution claim and claimed_cycle=cycle_index+1; perform the transient resolved_claimed phase, inject the exact response, append the complete consumed event, mark consumed, increment revision relative to admission, release the record claim while retaining the checkpoint execution claim for model/tool ownership, or write nothing

operations.name: reap_host_interaction_record
operations.atomic: reap only a matching checkpoint execution claim plus record claim; an open-transaction crash rolls back to resolved_pending, and no record-only claim is reaped

operations.name: claim_host_interaction_notification
operations.atomic: compare notification id, digest, state, owner, attempt, and lease; claim the independent UI notification outbox row

operations.name: complete_host_interaction_notification
operations.atomic: owner-attempt CAS marks the independent notification delivered or ambiguous; stale workers cannot complete it

operations.name: reconcile_host_interaction_notification
operations.atomic: compare stable notification id and payload digest, then CAS ambiguous to delivered, pending, or aborted; same outcome replays zero-write and a conflicting digest is rejected

operations.name: replay_controller_command
operations.atomic: same command_id and digest returns retained receipt without revision or second outbox increment

operations.name: suspend
